name: ANSI/IEEE maintained normally-open contact symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for maintained normally-open contact, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The maintained NO contact form combines a normally-open reference state with documented retention of an operated position. Its release or return mechanism needs a link so the reader does not assume momentary operation.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Find the action that returns the maintained contact.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: Maintained position describes retention; normally open describes the contact's reference state.
